Order:

(per Hon'ble Sri Justice P.Naveen Rao) This writ petition is filed seeking the following relief :
Prabhakar Kumar vs The State Of Telangana on 17 February, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/118819347/
1 "...to issue an appropriate Writ, Order or Direction, more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Habeas Corpus, directing 3rd respondent to produce the detenue i.e., Jitendra Kushwaha now detained in Central Prison, Cherlapally,
Medchal-Malkajgiri District before this Hon'ble Court and set-aside the impugned detention order passed by the 2nd respondent No.133/PD- CELL/CYB/2021 dated 13.08.2021 and confirmation order vide G.O.Rt.No.2441, dated 06.11.2021 passed by the 1st respondent as being illegal, arbitrary, improper, unilateral, unconstitutional and violative of Article 21 and 22 of the Constitution of India, and to forthwith release the Detenue and to grant such other relief or reliefs..."
2.

entities.text: Prabhakar Kumar vs The State Of Telangana on 17 February, 2022 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
This writ petition is instituted by the brother of detenu Jitendra Kushwaha, challenging the order of detention dated 13.08.2021 made under Section 3 (2) of the Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities of Bootleggers, Dacoits, Drug-Offenders, Goondas, Immoral Traffic Offenders,
Land-Grabbers, Spurious Seed Offenders, Insecticide Offenders, Fertilizer Offenders, Food Adulteration Offenders, Fake Documents Offenders, Scheduled Commodities Offenders, Forest Offenders, Gaming Offenders, Sexual Offenders, Explosive Substances Offenders, Arms Offenders,
Cyber Crime offenders and While Collar or Financial Offenders Act, 1986 (Act 1 of 1986).
3.

entities.text: Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities of Bootleggers, Dacoits, Drug-Offenders, Goondas
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Heard Sri P.Trivikram Reddy, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Government Pleader for home.

4. The order of detention was passed referring to involvement of the detenu in three crimes reported in Rajiv Gandhi International Airport Police Station (two crimes) and Medchal Police Station (one crime).
5.

entities.text: Rajiv Gandhi International Airport Police Station
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Against the co-accused in the same crimes also order of detention was passed on 13.08.2021.
Challenging the said detention order W.P.No.28000 of 2021 was filed on behalf of the co-accused.
This Court by order dated 06.12.2021 allowed the said writ petition setting aside the order of detention.

6. When the matter is called learned counsel for the petitioner as well learned Government Pleader submits that the subject matter of the writ petition is covered by the decision of this Court in W.P.No.28000 of 2021.
7. Following the same, and for the reasons assigned therein, this writ petition is also allowed setting aside the impugned detention order dated 13.08.2021.

The respondents are directed to set the detenu namely Jitendra Kushwaha, S/o.Rajender, Aged about 35 yrs, Occu : Vehicle Pollution Checking, R/o.H.No.1-11/8, Old Hafeezpet, Miyapur, Hyderabad of Telangana State at liberty forthwith, if he is no longer required in any other criminal case.
Pending miscellaneous petitions, if any, shall stand closed.

__________________ P.NAVEEN RAO,J ______________________ Dr. G.RADHA RANI,J 17th February, 2022 Rds Prabhakar Kumar vs The State Of Telangana on 17 February, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/118819347/
